title: किसानप्रेमीको ‘चेतना’ खण्डकाव्यमा प्रतिध्वनित दलित चेतना [Dalit consciousness echoed in the ‘consciousness’ fragment of Kisanpremi]
nepali: किसानप्रेमी (२०१९) नेपाली कविताकाव्यका क्षेत्रमा क्रियाशील स्रष्टा हुन् । आफू स्वयम् उत्पीडित वर्गमा जन्मी हुर्किएका हुनाल उनका रचनामा उत्पीडनको स्वर तीब्र रूपमा मुखरित भएको पाइन्छ । हिन्दू धर्मावलम्बीको बाहुल्य भएको नेपाली समाजमा दलितका नाममा निकै विभेद हुने गरेको भेटिन्छ । मूलतः दलित भनिएको सम्प्रदाय नेपाली समाजका प्रायः सबै भूगोल र परिवेशमा पाइन्छ । नेपालका मधेस, पहाड, हिमाल र राजधानी सहरका रूपमा परिचित काठमाडौँ उपत्यकामा समेत दलितहरूका उपस्थिति, अस्तित्व र पहिचान फेला पार्न सकिन्छ । दलितले भोग्नु परेका अवस्था र दलनका विरुद्ध उठ्ने प्रतिरोधी भावना न वास्तवमा दलित चेतना हो । समाजमा जहिलेदेखि दलनको सुरुवात भयो, त्यतिबेलादेखि नै दलनका विरुद्ध आवाज उठ्ने गरेका भए पनि त्यो आवाज सम्बन्धित निकायसम्म पुग्न नसकेकाले त्यत्तिकै बिलाएको थियो । नेपालमा दलनविरुद्ध छिटफुट रूपमा उठ्ने गरेको त्यस्ता आवाज वि.सं. २०६४ मा गणतन्त्र आएपछि भने निकै सशक्ततापूर्वक अगाडि बढेको पाइन्छ । हिजोआज मानव मानवका बीचमा जातका आधारमा हुने छुवाछुतजस्ता भेदभावजन्य व्यवहार विरुद्धको आवाज बुलन्द हुन थालेको छ । कवि किसानप्रेमीको चेतना खण्डकाव्य पनि नेपाली समाजका यस्तै दलितका पक्षमा आवाज उठाउँदै रचित मानवतावादी खण्डकाव्य हो । यसर्थ यहाँ दलित चेतनालाई आधार बनाएर उक्त खण्डकाव्यको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ ।
american_english: Kisanpremi (2019 BS) is an active creator in the field of Nepali poetry. Because he was himself born and raised in an oppressed class, the voice of oppression is found to be intensely articulated in his works. In Nepali society, where Hindus form the majority, considerable discrimination is found to occur in the name of Dalit. The community primarily referred to as Dalit is found in nearly all geographies and settings of Nepali society. The presence, existence, and identity of Dalits can be found even in the Madhesh, hills, mountains, and the Kathmandu Valley known as the capital city of Nepal. The resistant sentiment rising against the conditions endured by Dalits and against oppression is indeed Dalit consciousness. Ever since oppression began in society, even though voices were raised against oppression from that very time, those voices dissipated because they could not reach the relevant authorities. Such voices that were raised sporadically against oppression in Nepal are found to have advanced quite forcefully after the republic arrived in 2064 BS. Nowadays, voices against discriminatory behaviors such as untouchability based on caste between human beings have begun to resound loudly. Poet Kisanpremi's khandakavya 'Chetana' is also a humanist khandakavya composed while raising a voice in favor of such Dalits of Nepali society. Therefore, making Dalit consciousness the basis, an analysis of the said khandakavya is conducted here.

informal_english: Kisanpremi (2019 BS) is an active writer in the field of Nepali poetry. Having himself been born and brought up in an oppressed class, the voice of oppression is found to be strongly expressed in his works. In Nepali society where Hindus are in the majority, a lot of discrimination is found to take place in the name of Dalit. The community basically called Dalit is found in almost all geographies and environments of Nepali society. One can find the presence, existence, and identity of Dalits even in the Madhesh, hills, mountains, and the Kathmandu Valley known as the capital city of Nepal. The feeling of resistance rising against the hardships Dalits have to face and against oppression is indeed what Dalit consciousness is all about. Ever since oppression started in society, even though voices were raised against oppression from that very time itself, those voices simply died down without reaching the concerned authorities. Such voices that were raised here and there against oppression in Nepal have advanced quite forcefully after the republic came in 2064 BS. Nowadays, voices against discriminatory behaviour like untouchability based on caste between human beings have started ringing out loud and clear. Poet Kisanpremi’s khandakavya 'Chetana' is also a humanist khandakavya composed raising a strong voice in favour of such Dalits in Nepali society. So, taking Dalit consciousness as the main basis, an analysis of the said khandakavya has been carried out here.
translator_notes: Source text contains minor typographical and joining artefacts (हुनाल for हुनाले, दलितहरूका उपस्थिति, भावना न for भावना नै); translated sentence by sentence in strict 11-sentence order. Bikram Sambat years (2019 BS, 2064 BS) and technical literary genre (खण्डकाव्य / khandakavya) preserved. Informal flavour: Indian English.
